name: Accutron
old_description: electronic printed circuit board assembly. Our reputation is founded upon over 35 years
about:
Accutron, based in Windsor, Connecticut, was established in 1989 as a contract manufacturer specializing in printed circuit board assembly. In September 2024, the company became part of Foxtronics EMS, a move intended to broaden its capabilities and increase its visibility in the electronics industry.

The company operates a 55,000-square-foot facility with a staff of 130-plus, offering full-service contract manufacturing that spans SMT and through-hole PCB assembly, box-build integration, engineering support for design for manufacturability and testability, and a dedicated quick-turn prototype line. Testing services include flying-probe, in-circuit, functional, and burn-in validation, while material management and supply-chain programs round out the offering.

Accutron serves the medical, aerospace, and telecommunications sectors, holding ISO 13485 for medical devices, AS 9100 for aerospace, and ITAR registration for defense-related work. Customers range from OEMs needing prototype runs to those requiring full-scale production and system-level integration.

The firm emphasizes a proactive management approach and a reputation built on simplifying complex technologies, competitive pricing, and swift time-to-market delivery, with traceability down to the component lot level through its Aegis manufacturing execution system.
